governorpet.name: Governorpet
governorpet.about:
Governorpet is one of the central business areas of Vijayawada and part of the Vijayawada Central mandal. Suryaraopet, Gandhinagar, Hanumanpet, Arundelpet, Satyanarayanapuram, Moghalrajpuram and Seetharampuram lie around it, so it sits at the heart of the older city. It is one of the city's textile trading areas, along with Besant Road and the old town, and the state transport corporation runs city and intercity buses from a Governorpet bus station. Much of the street frontage is given over to shops, hotels and showrooms, and families mostly live in the lanes behind the main streets.

Its central position means a tutor can reach Governorpet from almost any part of the city by city bus or auto, and Vijayawada Junction is close by for anyone coming in by train. The shopping streets stay crowded through the day, so a two-wheeler is the practical choice and parking a car at the door is rarely simple. Send a lane landmark and a phone number before the first class, and fix an evening slot once the markets have quietened. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

gandhinagar.name: Gandhinagar
gandhinagar.about:
Gandhinagar is a major commercial area of Vijayawada and the headquarters of the Vijayawada Central mandal, one of the four mandals formed when the old Vijayawada Urban mandal was divided in 2018. It lies beside Vijayawada Junction, which stands on Railway Station Road in neighbouring Hanumanpet, opened in 1888 and is today one of the busiest railway stations in the country. Governorpet and Vidyadharapuram are among its neighbours, and the residential lanes sit behind a busy commercial frontage.

For a tutor, this is one of the easiest places in the city to reach: trains, city buses and autos all converge here, so even a tutor from the outer suburbs can arrive by train or bus and walk or take a short auto ride for the last stretch. The flip side is that the roads around the station are crowded at train times and through the evening, and car parking is limited. Agree a fixed class time that avoids the station rush, give the tutor a clear lane landmark, and keep online sessions in mind for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

suryaraopet.name: Suryaraopet
suryaraopet.about:
Suryaraopet, often written Suryaraopeta, is a central locality in the Vijayawada Central mandal, counted among the newer parts of the city that grew beyond the old town. Housing is a mix of apartment buildings, independent houses and some open plots, and the locality is known for its many hospitals and clinics, which sit close together along its main streets. Arundelpet, Labbipet, Moghalrajpuram, Governorpet, Lakshmi Nagar, Seetharampuram, Christurajupuram, Bavajipet and Chuttugunta all border it.

Because it is surrounded by other central neighbourhoods, Suryaraopet draws easily on tutors from Labbipet, Governorpet and Moghalrajpuram, and Vijayawada Junction is close for anyone travelling by train. Streets near the hospitals carry steady traffic and visitors' vehicles, so parking is easier for a two-wheeler, and a tutor should check whether the home is a flat with a building gate or a house with doorstep arrival. Weekday evenings are busy on the main streets, so set a regular slot with a little margin. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

labbipet.name: Labbipet
labbipet.about:
Labbipet is a central Vijayawada locality in the Vijayawada Central mandal, close to MG Road, which locals usually call Bandar Road. That road runs from Benz Circle towards Eluru Road, roughly parallel to the Bandar Canal, and is one of the city's main shopping and entertainment streets. Homes in Labbipet are mainly two- and three-bedroom flats in apartment buildings, along with some independent houses and villas. Moghalrajpuram, Suryaraopet, Arundelpet, Siddhartha Nagar, Seetharampuram, Christurajupuram and Krishna Lanka are its neighbours.

Its position near Bandar Road means many tutors from the central and eastern parts of the city can reach it directly by city bus, auto or two-wheeler, and Vijayawada Junction is the main station for those coming by train. Most families here live in apartment buildings, so share the building name, flat number and a phone number for the guard before the demo. Bandar Road gets heavy shopping traffic in the evenings and at weekends, so a weekday slot set before the evening rush is easier to keep regular. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

moghalrajpuram.name: Moghalrajpuram
moghalrajpuram.about:
Moghalrajpuram, also spelt Mogalrajapuram, is a residential and commercial district of Vijayawada that sits beside a range of low hills. It takes its name from the rock-cut cave shrines dedicated to Shiva in its hills, dating from around the fifth century and among the earliest examples of rock-cut architecture in south India. Apartments make up most of the homes on the market, with some builder floors and plots, and newer residential buildings stand alongside older streets and shops.

The locality links easily with Suryaraopet, Governorpet, Besant Road, Labbipet and Seetharampuram, and roads lead on towards Gunadala, Benz Circle and Ramavarappadu, so tutors can come from several directions. Vijayawada Junction and Ramavarappadu are the nearest railway stations. In apartment buildings, tell the guard the tutor's name before the first visit; for houses in the lanes near the hills, a temple or cave landmark helps the tutor find the door. The shopping streets are busiest in the evenings, so pick a regular slot that avoids the peak. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

benz-circle.name: Benz Circle
benz-circle.about:
Benz Circle is both the busiest road junction in Vijayawada and a major residential and commercial locality in the east-central part of the city. The name comes from a vehicle-making facility that once stood at the junction, and a bus stop nearby is still known locally as the Benz Company stop. National Highways 16 and 65 meet here, MG Road (Bandar Road) begins here, and a two-phase flyover on the highway now carries through traffic over the junction. Housing is mostly low-rise and mid-rise flats, with some residential plots.

Patamata, Patamatalanka, Auto Nagar, Darsipeta, Fakirgudem and Gayatri Nagar surround the junction, so families have a wide pool of nearby tutors to choose from. Madhura Nagar and Ramavarappadu stations are the closest suburban stops, with Vijayawada Junction for main-line trains. A metro network for the city is planned, but nothing is running yet. Apartment buildings usually ask visitors to sign in at the gate. Because the junction carries such heavy traffic, ask the tutor to avoid crossing it at office hours, or choose someone already living on the same side. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

patamata.name: Patamata
patamata.about:
Patamata is a central neighbourhood of Vijayawada in the Vijayawada East mandal. Once a separate village panchayat, it was merged into the municipal corporation in 1985 along with Gunadala and Bhavanipuram. It lies between Benz Circle and Auto Nagar, which makes it a major transit point for traffic, and it has a strong mix of shops and homes. Housing is mainly two- and three-bedroom apartments, with residential plots making up much of the rest.

Benz Circle, Patamatalanka, Ramalingeswara Nagar, Bharathi Nagar and Subbarao Colony are its neighbours, so tutors from across the eastern half of the city can reach it by city bus, auto or two-wheeler. Most families here live in apartment buildings, so register the tutor's name with the guard and share the block and flat number before the demo. Because traffic between Benz Circle and Auto Nagar passes through Patamata, a tutor coming from the far side of the junction should allow extra margin at office hours, and online classes are a useful option for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

currency-nagar.name: Currency Nagar
currency-nagar.about:
Currency Nagar is a residential neighbourhood on the eastern side of Vijayawada, listed among the city's main residential colonies. Homes are a mix of builder floors, independent houses and apartment buildings, with two-bedroom flats the most sought-after. Its neighbours include Sanath Nagar, Jayaprakash Nagar, Divine Nagar, Kanuru and Prasadampadu, and Ramavarappadu and Gunadala also lie close by.

For home tuition, Currency Nagar sits between the central city and the Kanuru and Ramavarappadu side, so tutors can come from either direction by two-wheeler, auto or city bus. Ramavarappadu, the next locality, has its own railway station on the loop line, and Vijayawada Junction serves main-line trains. On colony streets with houses and builder floors, the tutor can usually come straight to the door; apartment buildings may want the tutor's name in advance. The roads towards Benz Circle and the Ramavarappadu ring are busy at office hours, so a class time set outside the evening peak works more reliably. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ramavarappadu.name: Ramavarappadu
ramavarappadu.about:
Ramavarappadu is a residential hub in the east-central part of Vijayawada and one of the city's major localities. It is a census town in the Vijayawada Rural mandal and was brought into the Vijayawada metropolitan area by a government order in 2017. Currency Nagar, Gunadala and Prasadampadu are its neighbours. The Ramavarappadu ring is the eastern end of the Inner Ring Road, which runs from the Gollapudi Y-junction and links National Highways 16 and 65.

Ramavarappadu railway station, on the Vijayawada-Nidadavolu loop line, gives the locality its own rail link, and it is also used by pilgrims visiting the Gunadala shrine during its annual festival. For tutors, the Inner Ring Road makes it practical to come across from the western side of the city without going through the centre. Ask the family whether the home is a house with doorstep arrival or a flat with a building gate, and give a landmark near the ring for the first visit. The ring junction is busy at office hours, so plan a regular slot outside the evening rush. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

gunadala.name: Gunadala
gunadala.about:
Gunadala is a neighbourhood on the north-eastern side of Vijayawada that was a separate village panchayat until it was merged into the municipal corporation in 1985. Eluru Road, one of the city's two main arterial roads, runs straight into it, and Gunadala Main Road and Machavaram Down Road connect it with the surrounding junctions. Homes are a mix of traditional houses and newer apartment buildings. The locality is widely known for the Gunadala Matha shrine on its hill, a Marian pilgrimage site founded in the 1920s with a grotto and a large cross at the summit.

Gunadala railway station is a satellite station of Vijayawada on the main line, and Madhura Nagar station is also close. The shrine's annual festival in February draws very large crowds, so it makes sense to move classes online or reschedule them during those days. On other days, tutors arrive by city bus, auto or two-wheeler along Eluru Road. Houses usually mean doorstep arrival, while apartment buildings may keep a visitor register. Eluru Road is busy at office hours, so fix a slot with some margin. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

machavaram.name: Machavaram
machavaram.about:
Machavaram is a residential locality in the Vijayawada Central postal area, and Machavaram Down is counted among the parts of the city that developed beyond the old town. Homes here include independent houses, villas and residential plots, with plots in particular demand. It is surrounded by a ring of colonies: Divine Nagar, Gunadala, Veterinary Colony, LIC Colony, Jayaprakash Nagar, Madhura Nagar, Subbarao Colony, Siddhartha Nagar, Seetharampuram and Christurajupuram.

Machavaram Down Road links the locality with Gunadala and Eluru Road, and Madhuranagar railway station, a halt in use since the late nineteenth century, lies in the neighbouring colony. Because so many colonies adjoin it, families here can usually find a tutor based within the same part of the city, which keeps travel simple. Most homes are houses, so the tutor arrives at the door; share the house number and a nearby landmark, since colony lanes can look alike on a first visit. Roads towards Eluru Road fill up in the evening, so an early-evening slot is often the easiest to keep. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

satyanarayanapuram.name: Satyanarayanapuram
satyanarayanapuram.about:
Satyanarayanapuram, also written Satyanarayana Puram, is one of the established residential neighbourhoods of Vijayawada, listed alongside colonies such as Gayatri Nagar, Currency Nagar and Bharathi Nagar. Homes are mainly two- and three-bedroom flats in apartment buildings, with some villas and older houses. Governorpet, Suryaraopet, Arundelpet, Ayodhyanagar, Lakshmi Nagar, Bavajipet, Chuttugunta, Durgapuram and Durga Agraharam are its neighbours, placing it between the central business streets and the northern colonies.

That position works well for home tuition: tutors from Governorpet and Suryaraopet on one side and Ajit Singh Nagar and Ayodhyanagar on the other can reach it easily by two-wheeler, auto or city bus, and Vijayawada Junction is the main station for anyone travelling in by train. In apartment buildings, give the guard the tutor's name and the flat number before the first class. Roads into the central business area are crowded at office hours, so agree a regular slot that keeps the tutor out of the evening rush, and consider online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ajit-singh-nagar.name: Ajit Singh Nagar
ajit-singh-nagar.about:
Ajit Singh Nagar is a largely residential neighbourhood in northern Vijayawada, often grouped with the older One Town side of the city. It has stayed mostly residential, with many families living there for years and everyday shops, bakeries and clinics within walking distance. Independent houses and plots make up most of the homes, with some two-bedroom flats. Payakapuram, PNT Colony, Ayodhyanagar, Madhura Nagar, Devi Nagar and Lakshmi Nagar are its neighbours; Payakapuram was merged into the municipal corporation in 1985.

Because most homes are houses, a tutor usually arrives straight at the door, so a house number and a nearby landmark are all that is needed. Madhura Nagar station is close for local trains, and Vijayawada Junction is reached by road. Tutors mostly come by two-wheeler or auto, and those from Satyanarayanapuram, Ayodhyanagar and Payakapuram are the closest. Lanes in settled residential areas like this can be narrow, so a car is less convenient than a two-wheeler. Set a fixed weekday slot and use online classes when the right specialist lives further away. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

one-town.name: One Town (old city)
one-town.about:
One Town, also called the Old Town or I-Town, is the old city area of Vijayawada and a major commercial district. It takes in neighbourhoods such as Arjuna Veedhi, Islampet, Jendachettu Centre, Kamsalipet, Rajarajeswaripet, Kothapet and Winchipet, and its markets, including the textile trade, are among the busiest in the city. Historic rock-cut caves, an office of the Archaeological Survey of India and a gosala are among its landmarks. Durga Agraharam and Vinchipeta are close neighbours.

Many families here live in older houses along the lanes of the old city, where the tutor arrives at the doorstep and a two-wheeler or e-rickshaw is far easier than a car. The market streets are crowded for most of the day, so share a precise lane landmark and a phone number before the first class, and expect the tutor to walk the last stretch. Vijayawada Junction is close for tutors travelling by train. Choose a fixed slot after the market rush eases, and use online classes for specialist subjects when the right tutor lives across the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

vidyadharapuram.name: Vidyadharapuram
vidyadharapuram.about:
Vidyadharapuram, often spelt Vidhyadharpuram, is a residential locality on the western side of central Vijayawada, close to the Kanaka Durga temple on the hill above the Krishna. Housing is a mix of apartment buildings, villas and residential plots, with several newer apartment projects. Gollapudi, Bhavanipuram, Old Rajarajeswaripet, Gandhinagar, Kamsalipet, Mahantipuram, RR Nagar and Chitti Nagar are its neighbours, so it links the old city with the western suburbs.

For tutors, Vidyadharapuram is reachable both from the central areas around Gandhinagar and from the Bhavanipuram and Gollapudi side, mostly by two-wheeler, auto or city bus, and Vijayawada Junction is the main railway station. In apartment buildings, share the building and flat number with the guard in advance; plotted lanes usually allow doorstep arrival. Roads near the temple become very crowded during the Navaratri festival season, so families may prefer online sessions or adjusted timings then. On ordinary days, a fixed early-evening slot keeps classes regular. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bhavanipuram.name: Bhavanipuram
bhavanipuram.about:
Bhavanipuram is a residential hub on the west-central side of Vijayawada, in the Vijayawada West mandal. It was a separate village panchayat until it was merged into the municipal corporation in 1985. Until the 1990s the area was mostly vacant plots, estates and roadside eateries; commercial activity then shifted here from the city centre as the western suburbs grew, and today it has both shops and homes. It borders the Vijayawada bypass road and National Highway 65, and its neighbours include Krishna Lanka, Gollapudi, Jakkampudi, Vidyadharapuram, Chitti Nagar and Kabela.

The Kanaka Durga flyover, opened in 2020, runs from Bhavanipuram towards the main bus station and crosses NH 65, which has made the trip into the city centre much smoother for tutors. City buses also serve the area, including a route through to Penamaluru. Families in colony houses can expect the tutor at the door, while apartment buildings may keep a gate register. Highway traffic is heavy at office hours, so a tutor from Bhavanipuram, Gollapudi or Vidyadharapuram is the simplest match for regular evening classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

gollapudi.name: Gollapudi
gollapudi.about:
Gollapudi is a suburb on the western side of Vijayawada, on the road towards Hyderabad and beside the Krishna river. It lies in the Vijayawada Rural mandal, was the most populous village in that mandal, and became part of the Vijayawada metropolitan area by a government order in 2017. National Highway 65 and the Vijayawada bypass road pass through it, and the Inner Ring Road begins at the Gollapudi Y-junction. Homes are a mix of apartments, independent houses and residential plots.

Bhavanipuram and Vidyadharapuram are its nearest city neighbours, with Rayanapadu and Guntupalli further out. Rayanapadu station, developed as a satellite station to ease the load on Vijayawada Junction, serves this side of the city. State transport buses link Gollapudi with the main bus station and the railway station, so a tutor can come by bus as well as by two-wheeler. Independent houses allow doorstep arrival; apartment buildings may want the tutor's name at the gate. Highway traffic peaks at office hours, so pick a regular slot that avoids it. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kanuru.name: Kanuru
kanuru.about:
Kanuru is a neighbourhood on the eastern side of Vijayawada, close to Bandar Road and well connected to Eluru Road as well. It was brought into the Vijayawada metropolitan area by a government order in 2017, and at the end of 2020 it was merged with Tadigadapa, Poranki and Yenamalakuduru to form a single municipality. Kanuru is known as one of the major educational hubs of the city. Apartments are the most common homes, followed by plots, builder floors and independent houses.

Currency Nagar, Tadigadapa, Poranki and Penamaluru are its neighbours, and Patamata and Auto Nagar lie towards the city. Tutors mostly come along Bandar Road by two-wheeler, auto or city bus. A metro network for Vijayawada is planned but not yet running. As an education hub, roads near the main teaching institutions are busiest when classes begin and end, so agree a home tuition slot away from those hours. In apartment buildings, share the block and flat number with the guard before the first visit. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

tadigadapa.name: Tadigadapa
tadigadapa.about:
Tadigadapa lies on the eastern edge of Vijayawada in the Penamaluru mandal and is part of the Vijayawada urban agglomeration. At the end of 2020 the state government formed a new municipality by merging Tadigadapa with the neighbouring villages of Kanuru, Poranki and Yenamalakuduru, and the area is described as an industrial, commercial, educational and residential hub. Newer housing here leans towards villas and larger three-bedroom flats, with several recent residential projects.

Poranki, Penamaluru, Kanuru, Ayyappa Nagar, Auto Nagar and Patamata are its neighbours, so families can draw on tutors from both the city side and the Bandar Road suburbs. Tutors usually come by two-wheeler, car or auto, as there is no railway station in the locality itself. Villa communities and apartment projects often have a gated entrance, so register the tutor with security and ask about a regular visitor pass. Traffic on the main road towards Benz Circle builds at office hours, so a class time outside the evening peak, or online sessions for specialist subjects, keeps things simple. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

poranki.name: Poranki
poranki.about:
Poranki is a developing residential locality on the eastern side of Vijayawada, in the Penamaluru mandal. It became part of the Vijayawada metropolitan area by a government order in 2017, and is now one of the four villages merged into a single municipality with Kanuru, Tadigadapa and Yenamalakuduru. Bandar Road, lined with shops and eateries, connects Poranki with the city, while a quieter canal road runs parallel to one of the main canals. Homes include apartments, independent houses, villas and residential plots.

Penamaluru, Tadigadapa, Ashok Nagar and Kanuru are its neighbours, which gives families a good choice of tutors along the Bandar Road belt. Ramavarappadu and Nidamanuru are the nearest railway stations, but most tutors arrive by two-wheeler, auto or city bus along Bandar Road. A tutor coming from the city can use the canal road when Bandar Road is crowded in the evening. Independent houses and plotted lanes allow doorstep arrival, while apartment buildings and villa communities usually check visitors at the gate. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

penamaluru.name: Penamaluru
penamaluru.about:
Penamaluru is a locality on the eastern side of Vijayawada, beside the Krishna river, and the headquarters of the Penamaluru mandal. It was made part of the Vijayawada metropolitan area in 2017. The Gudivada-Vijayawada road is its main link, with Bandar Road and the Penamaluru bus stand serving as its local market hub. Homes range from apartments to independent houses, and residential plots are in strong demand.

Poranki, Tadigadapa, Kanuru and Nidamanuru are its neighbours, and several city bus routes run from Penamaluru to the main bus station and the railway station, so a tutor can come by bus as well as by two-wheeler. Nidamanuru and Madhura Nagar are the nearest railway stations. As this is the outer edge of the Bandar Road belt, a tutor based in Penamaluru, Poranki or Kanuru is the most practical choice for regular classes, while online sessions suit specialist subjects where the right tutor lives in the city centre. Houses usually mean doorstep arrival, and apartment buildings may keep a visitor register. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Central Vijayawada.fact: Vijayawada Central mandal, headquartered at Gandhinagar, was formed in 2018 when the Vijayawada Urban mandal was split into four; it includes Gandhinagar, Governorpet, Bavajipet, Suryaraopet, Labbipet and parts of Krishna Lanka.
Vijayawada Junction railway station, on Railway Station Road in Hanumanpet, dates from 1888 and is in the Vijayawada division of the South Coast Railway zone.
MG Road, popularly called Bandar Road, runs from Benz Circle to Eluru Road, roughly parallel to the Bandar Canal; MG Road and Eluru Road are the city's main arterial roads.
The Mogalrajapuram cave shrines, dedicated to Shiva, date from around the fifth century and are among the earliest rock-cut architecture in south India.
The state transport corporation runs city and intercity bus services from a Governorpet bus station, among others.
Vijayawada Municipality was established on 1 April 1888 and became a municipal corporation in 1981.

Benz Circle & Patamata.fact: Benz Circle, where National Highways 16 and 65 meet, is the busiest junction in Vijayawada.
The Benz Circle flyover was built in two phases; the second phase opened for public use on 6 November 2021.
Patamata, Gunadala and Bhavanipuram village panchayats, along with Payakapuram, were merged into the municipal corporation in 1985.
The Inner Ring Road runs from the Gollapudi Y-junction to the Ramavarappadu ring, linking NH 16 and NH 65; it was inaugurated in July 2016.
Ramavarappadu railway station lies on the Vijayawada-Nidadavolu loop line in the Vijayawada railway division.
Ramavarappadu was among the villages of Vijayawada Rural mandal added to the Vijayawada metropolitan area by G.O. 104 of 23 March 2017.
A metro network for Vijayawada is planned, with routes proposed through Benz Circle and the Bandar Road suburbs; it is not yet built.

Eluru Road & North.fact: Gunadala railway station is a satellite station of Vijayawada on the Vijayawada-Rajahmundry section of the Howrah-Chennai main line.
The Gunadala Matha shrine was founded in 1924; its annual festival is held in February and draws very large numbers of pilgrims.
Madhuranagar railway station (MDUN), established in 1899, serves Vijayawada on the Duvvada-Vijayawada section and the branch lines towards Gudivada and Machilipatnam.
Eluru Road and MG Road are the main arterial roads of Vijayawada.
Satyanarayana Puram and Bharathi Nagar are listed among the city's main residential neighbourhoods, and Machavaram Down among its newer areas.
Gunadala station is being upgraded under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme to ease crowding at Vijayawada Junction.

One Town & West.fact: One Town, the old city area, includes Arjuna Veedhi, Islampet, Jendachettu Centre, Kamsalipet, Rajarajeswaripet, Kothapet and Winchipet.
The Kanaka Durga flyover, a six-lane flyover from Bhavanipuram near Gollapudi towards the Pandit Nehru bus station, intersecting NH 65, opened in 2020.
Bhavanipuram, in Vijayawada West mandal, borders the Vijayawada bypass road and National Highway 65; commercial activity shifted there from the city centre in the 1990s.
Gollapudi, in Vijayawada Rural mandal, was added to the Vijayawada metropolitan area by G.O. 104 of 23 March 2017.
Rayanapadu railway station was developed as a satellite station to ease congestion at Vijayawada Junction.
The Inner Ring Road begins at the Gollapudi Y-junction.

Kanuru & Poranki.fact: On 31 December 2020 the state government formed a first-grade municipality by merging Yenamalakuduru, Kanuru, Tadigadapa and Poranki.
Kanuru, in Penamaluru mandal, became part of the Vijayawada metropolitan area by G.O. 104 of 23 March 2017.
Poranki, in Penamaluru mandal, became part of the Vijayawada metropolitan area by G.O. 104 of 23 March 2017.
Penamaluru is the headquarters of Penamaluru mandal and was made part of the Vijayawada metropolitan area in 2017.
Bandar Road connects Poranki with the city, and a quieter canal road runs parallel to one of the main canals.
The Gudivada-Vijayawada road is the main road through Penamaluru.
